contract: Radiant editable drawing SVG DOM compatibility

verification.browserOracle: Chrome 150 initial SVG render captured for Raphaël, maxGraph, and JointJS on 2026-08-01

capabilities.notes: All probes create, destroy, and recreate one library-owned SVG host.
SVGElement, SVGSVGElement, SVGGraphicsElement, SVGPathElement, SVGTextContentElement, and SVGAngle use native prototypes over the retained DOM tree.
setAttributeNS/getAttributeNS/removeAttributeNS preserve XLink href and XMLSerializer emits its namespace-qualified spelling.
Native getBBox, createSVGMatrix/createSVGPoint, DOMMatrix/DOMPoint, getCTM, and getScreenCTM use Radiant geometry and affine transforms.
Shape, path, group, and font-backed text boxes are covered by the direct contract and JointJS text geometry assertion.
DOMParser parses SVG XML and XMLSerializer serializes the native SVG tree, including XLink href.
The real graph receives pointer drag, wheel, focused keyboard movement, resize, reconnect, pan/zoom, undo/redo, and destroy/recreate events.
The real SVG Paper supports drag, wheel, focused keyboard movement, link reconnect, tools, scale/translate, text getBBox, and destroy/recreate.
Every drawing fixture asserts one SVG projection and zero canvas nodes.
